name: audit
description: The audit log: consumes audit events and exposes them read-only.

events.name: audit.entry.recorded
events.description: Published by the platform on behalf of the module that made a change (spec/events.md, section 1); this module owns the type.

events.name: audit.host-entry.recorded
events.description: Published by the platform for entries with no tenant; this module owns the type.

events.name: audit.entry.recorded
events.description: Consumed by this module, which writes the entry to the log.

events.name: audit.host-entry.recorded
events.description: Consumed by this module, which writes the entry to the host store.
